mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, name, created_at, updated_at, archived_at, compartment_id, display_color, data_residency, external_key_id, tags
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspaces ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, name, created_at, updated_at, compartment_id, display_color, data_residency, external_key_id, tags ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.Name}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CompartmentID}, #{params.DisplayColor}, CAST(#{params.DataResidency} AS jsonb), #{params.ExternalKeyID}, CAST(#{params.Tags} AS jsonb) ) RETURNING
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM workspaces
organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID}
AND archived_at IS NULL
AND (created_at, uuid) > (#{anchor.CreatedAt}, #{anchor.UUID})
AND (created_at, uuid) < (#{anchor.CreatedAt}, #{anchor.UUID})
ORDER BY created_at DESC, uuid DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspaces (external_id, organization_uuid, name) VALUES (#{externalID}, #{organizationUUID}, #{name}) ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO UPDATE SET organization_uuid = excluded.organization_uuid, name = excluded.name RETURNING uuid
